title: Conditions of Sale for Live Animals Covered by the Live Pet Health Guarantee
content:
**Condition of sale.** A live animal covered by the Live Pet Health Guarantee is sold only to a purchaser of at least the youngest purchaser age for its guarantee type, with a habitat check on record where the type requires one, no more than the largest number of animals per purchase line for the type, after the store's holding period before sale for the type has passed, and with the species care sheet and the acclimation guide. Pals Rewards certificates are not accepted on live animals; live animals earn Pals Rewards points only according to the earn multiplier set for the type; and a habitat starter kit bought with the animal takes the starter kit discount set for the type.

The figures each condition turns on (the youngest purchaser age, the habitat check, the largest number per line, the holding period, the care sheet and acclimation guide, the earn multiplier, the Tailwise Plus discount on the animal, the stocking guideline used at the habitat check, the treatment of feeder animals, live food and invertebrates, and whether the guarantee transfers to a new owner) are those set for the guarantee type.

## The conditions taken one at a time

| Condition | What is examined | Holds when |
|---|---|---|
| Purchaser age | the age of the purchaser of record | it is at least the youngest age for the type |
| Habitat | a habitat appropriate to the species, bought or confirmed by staff | it is on record at purchase, where the type requires the check |
| Quantity | the number of animals on the purchase line | it does not exceed the largest number for the type |
| Holding period | the days the store has held the animal | the holding period for the type has passed |
| Care materials | the species care sheet and the acclimation guide | they are given with the animal as the type provides |

## Combinations of the two entry conditions

The sale is made **only** to a purchaser who meets both the age condition and the habitat condition, so the remaining rows follow:

| Purchaser at least the youngest age | Habitat check on record | May the animal be sold? |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | the entry conditions are met |
| Yes | No | No |
| No | Yes | No |
| No | No | No |

## Payment and rewards at the till

- A Pals Rewards certificate cannot be used to pay for the animal, whatever the guarantee type.
- Points on the animal are earned only by the earn multiplier for the type; a multiplier of 0 earns no points.
- The starter kit discount applies to a habitat starter kit bought with the animal, not to the animal itself.

Hypothetical illustration: a purchaser of record exactly the youngest age for the type, with a staff-confirmed habitat on record, buying no more than the largest number per line of an animal whose holding period has passed, meets every listed condition of sale.
